label: Bible Study
prompt: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as _____ in the world;
verse: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
note: Shining like stars in a crooked world — Paul's picture of a faithful church.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Make a joyful _____ unto the LORD, all ye lands.
verse: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
note: Make a joyful noise — note it says noise, not a perfect performance. Everyone qualifies.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And she made him sleep upon her _____; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.
verse: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.
note: Modern versions say 'lap'; the KJV has Delilah lull Samson to sleep upon her knees before calling for the barber.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the _____; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
verse: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
note: Paul's charge to young Timothy: watch your life and your teaching — both have saving stakes.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But we all, with open face beholding as in a _____ the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
verse: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
note: In the KJV a 'glass' is a mirror — beholding the Lord's glory, we're changed 'from glory to glory.'
